_published_faq.name: How do I add Fleet Connected Apps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fleet Connected Apps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fleet-mcp-baseline.oedum.chatgpt.site/connected-tools-technical.

_published_faq.name: Is Fleet Connected Apps MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, Fleet Connected Apps scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Fleet Connected Apps's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, Fleet Connected Apps scores 88/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 4 of 4 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fleet Connected Apps?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fleet Connected Apps in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and inkbox.
